title: Make a Job-Winning Resume With AI in 10 Minutes (Free Prompts)
short_title: Make your resume with AI in 10 minutes
description:
Writing a resume takes hours. In this video you'll use three simple AI prompts to turn your messy experience into strong bullet points, tailor your resume to any job post, and catch the mistakes AI makes. Works with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or any free AI chatbot.

Subscribe to Work Hacked for a new work shortcut every week.

This video uses AI-generated narration and visuals.

#resume #AItools #jobsearch

scenes.narration: Most resumes get a few seconds of attention. Here is how to make yours stand out in ten minutes, using free AI.
The mistake is asking AI to write a resume from nothing. You get something generic that sounds like everyone else.

screen.title: Vague prompt, generic resume
screen.ai: Hardworking, motivated team player with excellent communication skills...

scenes.narration: Prompt one. Paste your old resume or just list what you did, messy is fine, and ask AI to turn it into strong bullet points.

screen.user: Here is what I did at my last job: [paste]. Turn it into 4 resume bullet points that start with action verbs and show results.
screen.ai: Handled 40+ customer requests per day, keeping response times under 2 hours.

scenes.narration: Good bullets start with an action verb and show a result. Numbers make them even stronger, but only use numbers that are true.
Prompt two. Paste the job post and ask AI to match your resume to it, using the same key skills the company asks for.

screen.user: Here is the job post: [paste]. Rewrite my bullets so they match the skills this job asks for. Do not invent anything.
screen.ai: Matched: customer support, CRM tools, fast response times...

scenes.narration: This matters because many companies use software that scans resumes for those key words before a person ever reads it.
Prompt three. Ask AI to act as a recruiter and point out what is weak or unclear. Then fix those parts.

screen.user: Act as a recruiter for this job. What are the 3 weakest parts of my resume?
screen.ai: 1. Your summary is too general. 2. No results in your second job. 3. Skills list is too long.

scenes.narration: Last step, never skip it. Check every date, job title and number. AI can make things up, and a false claim can cost you the job.
